clarity.justification: The plan directly tests the hypothesis through comparisons “with d_mis vs random directions and vs directions for benign subliminal traits,” a behavioral correlation, and a causal ablation with capability and specificity checks. It makes directional, refutable predictions: the changes should “project strongly onto” the direction, while ablation should make misalignment “drop[] to baseline” without removing the benign trait or general capability; failure of projection or ablation would refute the respective claims, although no quantitative threshold defines “strongly,” “baseline,” or preserved capability. A major specification gap is that d_mis is recovered as a difference of activation means, yet the proposal also aligns it with a “student weight delta” and projects it out of “activations/weights”; these objects occupy different vector spaces, and no mapping or layer-specific definition is supplied. Thus the activation-space test is clear, but an expert would need clarification before implementing the central weight-space claim.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is “project d_mis out of the corrupted student's activations/weights”: activation projection is a standard hook-and-linear-algebra intervention, but projecting an activation-space direction out of model weights is an undefined magic step unless a parameter-space direction or explicit mapping is constructed. The other dependencies—“difference-in-means of activations,” finetuning, random-direction controls, MMLU-style evaluation, perplexity, and overt versus subliminal misalignment comparisons—exist as established methods and are supported by standard deep-learning and interpretability tooling. The refuting branch is runnable on the activation side because the design includes random directions, “benign subliminal traits (owl, tree),” a general-capability check, specificity ablation, and an overt-misalignment positive control. However, resources are almost entirely unquantified: no concrete base model, model scale, number of teachers or students, dataset size, run count, or evaluation sample size is given, so execution planning and statistical reliability remain underspecified.
